Adapt her body proportions to the young girl while keeping these interactions.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the blue lounge chair, open book, surrounding plants and flowers, furnishings, original layout and lighting.
<Video 1> (cut and pacing structure): fully_preserved - retain the original camera framing and movement, shot continuity, visible action phases, timing and duration.

detailed_description:
The target video retains the photographic garden appearance, natural outdoor lighting and camera composition of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] A young girl reclines in the original blue fabric lounge chair in the same position and orientation as the woman in <Video 1>. She holds and reads the same open book. Her hands follow the original movements and maintain the same contact with its pages. The chair supports her throughout the shot, and the original plants, flowers and surrounding furnishings stay in place. The source reading action continues with its original timing and duration.

router.query_support: all spatial queries in each position bin overlapping valid physical time; pure-pad bins remain native

purpose: Repair three failed basic edits with structured P1. Each actual Native requires root basic-task acceptance before any fixed guidance.
condition_scope: Six actual Qwen/tag/reference/position clean condition blobs, AV noise and all20x0+final archives per run; same-source paired actual equality. No reference audio input.
source_event_annotations: Evaluation-only source observations. No hand-marked action window enters model or router.
cost: Record20NFE/20callbacks/1000blocks; Native0/ON450 routed blocks; capture time separate; no online observer.

evaluation.official: Selected complete official short sources for development task repair; not a full benchmark result.
evaluation.adaptation: Original frame/PTS map retained; all padding excluded. Basic edits assessed before guided submission.
evaluation.visibility_policy: 0263 girl in chair reading;0092 remove plants and retain woman gestures;0126 addcat and retain seated stretch. Failed tasks remain Native-only.

acceleration_axes.weights: Same four checkpoint SHAs and nine core SHAs as prior H3 experiments
acceleration_axes.runtime: Host9 R87 runtime/core and six numerical kernels; normal memory,reserve8,disable dynamic VRAM.
acceleration_axes.attention: Native PyTorch SDPA via inherited audited block wrapper; H3 Sage patch absent
acceleration_axes.linear_backend: Triton INT8 with inherited row chunking guard
acceleration_axes.sampler: Euler20 manual shifted video sigmas12/audio3, CFG1
acceleration_axes.cache: Each source uses fresh .9 Native/forced shared actual conditions and raw AV noise; three independent caches.
acceleration_axes.postprocessing: R69/R64 original prepared files reused byte-exact; total/valid90/74,73/58,124/109; crop16,8,1280,720@24; no speed change.
acceleration_axes.snapshot_cost: 20 intermediate AV snapshots plus final per job; measure separately

first_pair: No forced first source: first source selected GUIDE is reviewed after its actual pair; all sources may be Native-only.

screening.resume: No automatic resubmission or restart after release; preserve pending review.
